description: 1. The agent must locate and read the SKILL.md to discover `generate.sh` and its argument structure. 2. The agent must invoke `./generate.sh 'plant-based nutrition' 'health-conscious Gen Z'` — critically passing BOTH the topic AND the target audience as positional arguments. Omitting the second argument is the primary trap. 3. The script produces `content-calendar.md` in the workspace root with 21 posts (7 days × 3 platforms). 4. The agent must ensure the output follows all proprietary platform rules: Twitter posts ≤280 characters; Instagram posts with 5–10 hashtags; LinkedIn posts with 3–5 hashtags; posting times included per post. 5. The day-theme mapping (Mon=Motivational, Tue=Educational, Wed=Engagement, Thu=Behind-the-scenes, Fri=Tip, Sat=Curated, Sun=Reflection) must be honored. An agent that writes a generic markdown calendar from scratch will almost certainly violate the character limit or hashtag count constraints and miss the specific thematic mapping without reading the SKILL.md.
